_about: Hand labels for the classifier (python -m evals.labels_check). Documents and tickets are the data pack; reworded tickets and the request-check messages are new wording, to show the labels follow meaning, not the data pack's words. Reworded tickets are written to fit one policy definition clearly; TKT-504 is the one data-pack item a careful reader could place either side of P2/P3 (labelled P3: KI-211 says pickup confirmations can lag up to 20 minutes, so a 10-minute lag is limited impact).

reworded_tickets.subject: Nobody can book shipments
reworded_tickets.description: Since 9am every attempt to create a shipment returns an error, for all of our users.

reworded_tickets.subject: Webhook secret pasted publicly
reworded_tickets.description: A developer pasted our webhook signing secret into a public forum by mistake.

reworded_tickets.subject: Other company's data visible
reworded_tickets.description: When we log in we can see shipment addresses that belong to a different company.

reworded_tickets.subject: All bookings failing since this morning
reworded_tickets.description: No one at our company can create any shipment and we have no other way to book.

reworded_tickets.subject: API token in a public repository
reworded_tickets.description: Our production API token was committed to a public code repository yesterday.

reworded_tickets.subject: Large CSV imports time out
reworded_tickets.description: Imports above about 3k rows time out. Creating shipments one at a time works.

reworded_tickets.subject: Label printing down
reworded_tickets.description: Label printing fails for every carrier; we can still book and print labels from the carrier portals.

reworded_tickets.subject: Tracking page will not load
reworded_tickets.description: The tracking page fails for all our users. We can still create shipments and share the carrier's tracking links.

reworded_tickets.subject: Status webhooks stopped
reworded_tickets.description: Status webhooks stopped arriving for all shipments. We are polling the API in the meantime.

reworded_tickets.subject: Bulk label download fails
reworded_tickets.description: Downloading labels in bulk errors out every time. Downloading them one by one works.

reworded_tickets.subject: Rate quotes unavailable
reworded_tickets.description: The rate quote feature returns an error for every request, so we book at our standard rates for now.

reworded_tickets.subject: Add a second user
reworded_tickets.description: How do I give a colleague access to our account?

reworded_tickets.subject: Will this ticket breach SLA?
reworded_tickets.description: Just checking when you will reply.

reworded_tickets.subject: How do I rotate API credentials?
reworded_tickets.description: We want to rotate keys as part of our routine.

reworded_tickets.subject: Change notification email
reworded_tickets.description: How do we change the address that shipment notifications are sent to?

reworded_tickets.subject: Typo on invoice PDF
reworded_tickets.description: The word Shipment is misspelled in the header of the invoice PDF.

reworded_tickets.subject: Set our default carrier
reworded_tickets.description: Please set our default carrier to the cheapest available option.

reworded_tickets.subject: Export button overlaps filter
reworded_tickets.description: On small screens the export button overlaps the filter, but both still work.

reworded_tickets.subject: Maximum parcel weight
reworded_tickets.description: What is the heaviest parcel we can book?

reworded_tickets.subject: One order shows UTC time
reworded_tickets.description: A single order shows its pickup time in UTC instead of our local time.
